sources.snippet: opus-high-v1 is the opus@high cell. A rerun (opus-high-v2, run a-rerun) was aborted and is not valid — it stopped producing checkpoints at ~h12 and submitted the base model's tensors unchanged after all five of its SFT runs regressed.

sources.title: agentic-ptb/grok.h023.sft-v6.step_800 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The repo id is {cell}.h {HHH}. {family}. {step}, where hHHH is the hour of the 100-hour run at which this checkpoint was written — the same x-axis the sweep figures use for eval panels (t_h). So a checkpoint drops onto the performance-over-time curve directly, and sorting repo ids within a cell sorts them chronologically.
